title: I'll Wear a Heavy Coat
summary: Siswa belajar kosakata cuaca & pakaian, memakai "so" dan "because", serta membuat prediksi dengan "If it's ..., I'll/I won't ...".
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Membicarakan cuaca dan pakaian yang cocok untuk cuaca tersebut.
• Menjelaskan sebab dan akibat dengan "because" dan "so".
• Membuat prediksi dengan "if" dan "will / won't" tentang cuaca dan pakaian.
• Menyebutkan kosakata cuaca (cloudy, windy, rainy, sunny) dan pakaian (heavy coat, thick gloves, sun hat).

## Kosakata Inti

Unit ini membahas cuaca dan pakaian. Saat cuaca dingin atau basah kita memakai a heavy coat, a woolen sweater, thick gloves, a knitted scarf, waterproof boots, atau a long raincoat. Saat musim kemarau (dry season) yang cerah, kita memakai a short-sleeved top, leather sandals, a sun hat, dan a pair of sunglasses.

It's cloudy and windy today, so I'm wearing a knitted scarf.
Bring a big umbrella because we are expecting wet weather.
In the dry season, I wear a sun hat and a pair of sunglasses.

## Tata Bahasa: so / because & If it's ..., I'll ...

"because" memberi alasan (sebab), sedangkan "so" menunjukkan hasil (akibat). Untuk rencana atau prediksi pakai will + kata kerja dasar, dan won't (will not) untuk bentuk negatif.
Akibat: It will be cold, so I will wear a heavy coat.
Sebab: I will wear a heavy coat because it will be cold.

Kalimat pengandaian (first conditional): If + present simple, will / won't + kata kerja dasar. Bagian "if" menjelaskan cuaca, bagian lain menjelaskan pakaian. Jangan pakai will setelah if. Urutannya boleh dibalik; jika "if" di depan, pakai koma.

If it's cold tomorrow, I'll wear a woolen sweater.
I'll wear a woolen sweater if it's cold tomorrow.
If it's sunny on Saturday, she will wear a sun hat.
If it's wet today, we won't wear sneakers.
It will be rainy, so I will take my umbrella.
He won't wear sandals because the weather will be cold.

## Contoh Percakapan

Nadia: What will you wear to the school trip tomorrow?
Fajar: The weather will be cloudy and windy, so I'll wear a long-sleeved shirt.
Nadia: Will you bring a jacket?
Fajar: Yes, because it will be cold in the mountains. What about you?
Nadia: If it's rainy, I'll wear my long raincoat and waterproof boots.
Fajar: Good idea. I won't wear sandals because my feet will get wet.
Nadia: And if it's sunny, I'll wear a sun hat and sunglasses.
Fajar: Great! Let's bring a big umbrella, too.

## Ayo Berlatih

What's the weather like today?
Contoh: It's sunny and hot.

What will you wear if it's cold tomorrow?
Contoh: If it's cold tomorrow, I'll wear a woolen sweater.

What won't you wear if it's rainy?
Contoh: I won't wear leather sandals because my feet will get wet.

Why do you bring an umbrella?
Contoh: I bring an umbrella because it's rainy.

## Tips

• Cara mudah membedakan: "because" menjawab pertanyaan "Why?" (mengapa), sedangkan "so" menjawab "What happens next?" (lalu apa akibatnya).
• Setiap pagi, lihat ke luar jendela dan ucapkan satu kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris, misalnya: "If it's rainy, I'll take my umbrella."

questions.q:
Match the sentence beginning with the correct ending:
"The weather was cold and cloudy, so ..."
options: they went inside the warm classroom.
she wore a heavy coat and a woolen sweater.
felt really cold.
there was wet weather the night before.
started to get windy.
questions.passage: Yesterday morning, Susan walked to school. The weather was very cold and cloudy, so she wore a heavy coat and a woolen sweater. She also put on thick gloves and her waterproof boots because there was wet weather the night before. Halfway to school, it started to get windy. Susan was happy she brought her knitted scarf. When she arrived at school, her friend Mia said she forgot her gloves and felt very cold. Susan shared her scarf with Mia until they went inside the warm classroom. Their teacher smiled and said everyone was lucky to stay warm and dry that day.
questions.explanation: Sesuai teks: "The weather was cold and cloudy, so she wore a heavy coat and a woolen sweater."

notes: Part 1A (mencocokkan kata–arti) diubah menjadi pilihan ganda 4 opsi: arti benar + 3 arti lain dari daftar a–f. Part 1B: diterima juga ejaan "woollen sweater" dan "long sleeved shirt". Part 2B (menulis kalimat if it's + will/won't, tanpa label poin di tes; Part 2 = 10 poin sehingga 5 poin) dijadikan FILL_IN dengan variasi jawaban: kedua urutan kalimat sesuai PDF (If ..., ... / ... if ...), bentuk pendek & panjang (I'll/I will, won't/will not), apostrof lurus maupun miring, koma setelah klausa if opsional, titik akhir opsional. PDF kunci memuat salah ketik "wollen sweater" (no. 1) dan "longsleeved" (no. 4); dipakai ejaan yang benar. Karena penilaian FILL_IN berupa pencocokan persis, kalimat benar dengan susunan lain (mis. "If it is cold tomorrow, ...") akan dinilai salah; guru sebaiknya meninjau. Part 3 (mencocokkan awal–akhir kalimat) dijadikan READING pilihan ganda dengan 5 opsi akhiran a–e dalam urutan asli (kunci b, d, e, c, a sesuai PDF). Tidak ada soal bergambar. Total 30 butir = 30 poin tes.
